pfsModePolicy: The pinned MkPFS wraps the application folder in PPSA74126.exfat and stores that image in read-only PFS/PFSC with 0555 container inodes. exFAT has no POSIX execute permissions. ZIP preserves 0755 eboot/libc, 0644 other files. Contents, file lengths, paths and application metadata were verified after deep extraction; container inode permissions were parsed directly.
